raw_html: [[Sirocco#Greater Sirocco|Greater Sirocco]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sirocco#Greater Sirocco|Greater Sirocco]]:''' A critical hit with this weapon causes a whirlwind of desert sand to swirl about the target, temporarily [[Blinded|blinding]] it. A successful [[Reflex save]] (DC 35) prevents the effect.
